question.prompt: In January \(1980\) the Mauna Loa Observatory recorded carbon dioxide CO\({}_{2}\) levels of \(338\) ppm (parts per million). Over the years the average CO\({}_{2}\) reading has increased by about \(1.515\) ppm each year. What is the expected CO\({}_{2}\) level in ppm in January \(2030?\) Round your answer to the nearest integer.

solutions.explanation:
From January \(1980\) to January \(2030\), there are \(2030-1980=50\) years of increase. Using the given average annual increase, the total increase is
\[
50\cdot1.515=75.75\text{ ppm}.
\]
Add this to the starting reading:
\[
338+75.75=413.75\text{ ppm}.
\]
The tenths digit is \(7\), so rounding to the nearest integer gives \(\boxed{414}\) ppm, choice \(\boxed{\text{B}}\).
solutions.title: Add the increase over 50 years
